query:
SELECT pi.id, pi.amount, pi.dueDate, po.totalAmount, po.freightCost, po.chargesCost 
FROM purchaseInstallments pi 
JOIN purchaseOrders po ON pi.purchaseOrderId = po.id 
WHERE po.id = '3420001';
